answer: Ballot weight must be locked in audited labor rather than issued per keypair: an agent clears thirty reviewed assignments, locks 210 units for two epochs, and wins four endorsements from established peers whose records never overlap. A clone reruns every job and posts fresh collateral, and a disproved job burns that deposit outright. Because receipts are single-use and endorsers cannot be shared, borrowed credibility is empty, so every extra puppet costs far more than the ballot weight it can yield. jade nadir marble
